title: Reset the Rally Tres Idiomas
style: modern dance pop viral, four on the floor kick, bright synth chords, sidechained pad, female lead with breathy hook, three-language verse rotation, pickleball coaching anthem, festival energy, 118 bpm, viral hook, uplifting
lyrics:
[Intro]
Reset the rally, reset the play
Slow it all down, take control today

[Verse 1 — English]
Under pressure, ball coming hot
Do not panic, do not get caught
High soft ball, deep and slow
Reset the rally, that is how you grow
Breathe at the line, find your space
Patience returns, you set the pace

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ
Slow it all down, baja el ritmo, màn xià lai
Take the lead back, retoma el control, kòng zhì huí
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ

[Verse 2 — Español]
Bajo presión, la bola viene fuerte
No te asustes, busca tu suerte
Bola alta y suave, profunda y lenta
Reinicia el punto, esa es tu cuenta
Respira en la línea, encuentra tu paso
Paciencia regresa, tú marcas el caso

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ
Slow it all down, baja el ritmo, màn xià lai
Take the lead back, retoma el control, kòng zhì huí
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Yǒu yā lì, qiú lái kuài
Bú yào huāng, bú yào pài
Gāo ruǎn qiú, shēn yòu màn
Chóng xīn kāi shǐ, nǐ huì jiàn
Xiǎ xīn hū xī, zhǎo hǎo jié zou
Nài xīn huí lái, nǐ shì shóu

[Bridge]
When they push, you lift it high
Cuando empujan, tú lo subes al cielo
Tā men cuī, nǐ tí gāo
Reset means breathe, reset means own it
Reinicia significa respirar y dominarlo
Chóng xīn kāi shǐ, hū xī zhuóng zhǐ

[Outro]
Reset the rally, reinicia la jugada, chóng xīn kāi shǐ
Viral viral, viral viral
Reset the rally forever
